title: Embroidered Bear Quilted Tote Bag For On-the-go Diaper Storage
body_html:
Product Information：

Name: Bear quilted handbag
Fabric material: quilted cotton + polyester lining
Size: height about 23cm, top width about 28cm, bottom width about 20cm, bottom width about 8cm, hand lift about 14cm (manual measurement, allow 2~3cm error)
Cleaning method: hand wash in warm water (do not rub the embroidery part), naturally straighten and hang to dry
Color: beige
Note: Open opening and closing design, no inner pocket, no bear name tag


Packing List：

1* Bag
